# Flowboard

> Flowboard is a team Kanban board web app. Teams sign in to organize work on a shared board with four columns (Backlog, In Progress, In Review, Done). Each card has a title, assignee, priority (High, Medium, Low) and due date. Cards can be dragged or moved between columns, edited, and deleted with undo, and changes sync live between teammates.

The board itself is private and requires an account; only the public landing and sign-in page is crawlable.

## Features
- Four-column Kanban workflow with drag and drop plus a keyboard-accessible Move menu
- Card fields: title, assignee, priority, due date, with overdue highlighting
- Shared assignee list with duplicate prevention
- Real-time sync across teammates and browser tabs
- Built for accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA oriented): keyboard, screen reader and touch support
